name: Ebal
overview: Ebal is a male Edomite figure identified in Scripture as the son of Shobal. His mention is concise, with no additional details or notes provided beyond his lineage and tribal affiliation. As an Edomite, he is part of the broader family descending from Esau, reflecting the historical and genealogical records found in Genesis.
namesAndTitles: The name Ebal appears as a proper name in the biblical record without an explicit meaning or divine origin noted. Its mention is straightforward, serving primarily as an identifier within the genealogy.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ebal as the son of Shobal, establishing his immediate paternal relationship. No further family connections or relationships are detailed beyond this direct lineage.
scriptureSignificance: Ebal's significance lies in his place within the genealogical framework of the Edomites, as recorded in Genesis 36:23. His mention helps to trace the descendants of Esau and contributes to the understanding of the nations and peoples related to Israel. While not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion underscores the biblical emphasis on lineage and God's providential ordering of families and tribes.
